title: 私宅停车
evidence_note: p166 body: parking reduction possible for private houses; carports cheaper, better in building physics (no condensation) and space-saving.

title: 退距（Abstandsfläche）
issues: Omits the MBO exception in the same item 5: in front of outside walls of building classes 1 and 2 with ≤3 overground storeys, 3 m depth is sufficient (also 'some LBOs have further exceptions').
'退距须位于本地块内' omits that setback areas may also lie on public traffic/green/water areas up to their centre, or extend onto other plots secured by public law.
corrected_summary: 按示范建筑条例（MBO），退距深度为 0.4 H 且不小于 3 m（商业区和工业区为 0.2 H，不小于 3 m）；建筑等级 1 和 2、地上不超过三层的建筑外墙前，3 m 深度即足够；各州 LBO 规定不同并有其他例外。墙高 H 自地面量至墙顶或墙与屋面覆盖层交线，垂直于墙面测量；坡度 ≤ 70° 的屋面高度按 1/3 计入、≥ 70° 全部计入。退距须位于本地块内（也可延伸至公共交通、绿地或水域的中线，或延伸至依公法确定不可建造的其他地块）。檐口、挑檐等外墙突出构件若占墙宽合计 < 1/3、外挑 ≤ 1.50 m 且距对面地界 ≥ 2 m，则不计入退距。
evidence_note: p64 body items 2, 4, 5, 6 (Design process, setback areas per MBO).

title: 最佳坡度与踏步比
evidence_note: p121 body: physiologically best use of climbing effort at 30° pitch and r/t 17/29.

title: 必要楼梯宽度与踏步比
issues: Drops the source framing 'according to German standards' and that the value is a minimum usable stair width.

Context is residential buildings: the same sentence gives ≤2-flat houses min. 0.80 m (17/28), non-essential stairs 0.50 m (21/21), high-rise flats 1.25 m; summary states 1.00 m without this residential/German-standard context.
corrected_summary: 按德国标准（住宅建筑），法定必要楼梯（作为疏散路线）的可用梯宽至少 1.00 m、踏步比 17/28；对比：不超过两户的住宅楼梯可用宽度至少 0.80 m（17/28），非必要楼梯 0.50 m（21/21），高层住宅 1.25 m。
evidence_note: p120 body: 'According to German standards, residential buildings ... legally essential stairs 1.00 m, 17/28, high-rise flats 1.25 m'.

title: 螺旋楼梯
issues: Minor: source says 'permissible' (允许); summary reads as a plain statement but conditions are intact.
evidence_note: p124 body: spiral stairs permissible from 190 cm diameter as sole connecting stair inside houses with 80 cm usable width.

title: 公共建筑楼梯两侧扶手
evidence_note: p25 body (3) under '§ 50 of MBO': buildings per (2) = publicly accessible buildings; stairs must have handrails on both sides continued past landings, window openings and last steps.

title: 休息平台宽度不小于梯段宽度
issues: Parenthetical '（沿行进方向的进深）' is an interpretation not in the source caption, which only says 'Landing width ≥ stair width'.
Omits caption context: stairs with landings are required in legally essential stairways with storey height ≥ 2.75 m.
corrected_summary: 楼梯休息平台宽度不小于楼梯宽度；（同一图注）层高 ≥ 2.75 m 的法定必要楼梯须设休息平台。
evidence_note: p121 caption 6: 'Stairs with landings are required in legally essential stairways with a storey height of ≥ 2.75 m. Landing width ≥ stair width.'

title: 内门净高
evidence_note: p113 body table: clear opening height of internal doors minimum 210 cm (better 210–225 cm).

title: 无障碍门净宽
issues: Scope lost: the ≥0.90 m door width is from the 'Accessible Public Buildings' section (p22), and the step-free entrance ≥0.90 m is MBO §50 (3) for publicly accessible buildings per (2); summary presents both as generic accessible-design rules.
corrected_summary: 无障碍公共建筑中，门净通行宽度 ≥ 0.90 m；按 MBO §50，公众可达建筑须至少能经一个净开口宽度 ≥ 0.90 m 且无台阶的入口进入。
evidence_note: p22 'Accessible Public Buildings' Doors; p25 MBO §50 (3) referring to publicly accessible buildings (2).

title: 无障碍卫生间
issues: Scope lost: both rules come from the 'Accessible Public Buildings' section of p22; summary omits the public-building scope. Also 'per sanitary facility' wording is fine.
corrected_summary: 无障碍公共建筑中，所有卫生设施内须至少设一个供轮椅使用者使用的厕所（坐高宜为 48 cm）；厕所、淋浴间和更衣间的门须向外开。
evidence_note: p22 'Accessible Public Buildings': Sanitary facilities and Doors paragraphs.

title: 楼梯起止处活动区
issues: Scope lost: rule is from 'Accessible Public Buildings' (p22); summary is unscoped. (Accessible housing p23 has a similar rule but excludes the uppermost step's tread.)
corrected_summary: 无障碍公共建筑中，上下楼梯旁的活动区宽度至少 1.50 m，首级踏步的踏面不计入活动区。
evidence_note: p22 'Accessible Public Buildings' Stairs paragraph.

title: 无障碍住宅卫浴
evidence_note: p23 'Accessible Housing' Bathroom + movement areas 1.50×1.50 m (shower, in front of WC and vanity unit).

title: 两条独立疏散路线
evidence_note: p511 body Escape routes: two independent routes; non-ground-level units via essential staircase + second staircase or fire-brigade-reachable point; not required with safety stairwell.

title: 防火分区与防火墙
evidence_note: p513 body: MBO fire compartment walls subdividing larger buildings ≤40 m; F 90A; openings generally impermissible, allowed within buildings with T 90 self-closing doors.

evidence_note: p246 body High-rise buildings, Escape routes: all values and modalities (should/must/may) match.

title: 玻璃面最小高度 1.3 m

issues: Minor omission: exception for facilities with only one toilet without direct access to work rooms; not essential.
evidence_note: p270 body (Industry, workplace toilets): 100 m / one storey; >5 employees separate sexes (must) and exclusive to employees (should); lobby with ≥1 washbasin per 5 WCs.

title: 档案室
issues: 2.10 m ceiling clearance is given as a 'favourable' value (alongside favourable window centre-line 2.25–2.50 m), not a fixed requirement; summary states it as a plain fixed value.
corrected_summary: 文件室须干燥，因此阁楼和地下室不宜；文件区宜采用净高约 2.10 m（2 层普通办公 = 3 层文件存放；有利的窗中线高度为 2.25–2.50 m）；档案室宜按 7.5–12.5 kN/m² 的较高楼面荷载设计（针对移动式密集架）。
evidence_note: p237 body: 'A favourable window centre-line is 2.25–2.50 m, ceiling clearance height 2.10 m (2 storeys ... = 3 storeys of filing). The rooms must be dry...'; p238 archive rooms 7.5–12.5 kN/m².
